svg.aria-label: The smoothed octagon from its definition: the six points s₀, …, s₅ of a regular hexagon on the unit circle (white dots), and the six arcs g(t) s_j, 0 ≤ t ≤ t_f, that the trajectory g moves them along. Each arc runs from s_j to s_(j+1); together they close up into one convex curve, the boundary of K, and K is their convex hull

svg.text: convex hull of the six arcs
